name: productnow
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to ProductNow's context engine through the hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription: ProductNow connects ChatGPT and Codex to your organization's ProductNow context engine through MCP. It can search and read accessible context, open folders and document versions, create or edit documents, comment, move, archive, and track review workflows. Actions are limited to the connected ProductNow account and workspace permissions.
